notes.title: The SAVE & RELOAD update is here!
notes.notes:
Yee'haw pardners, I've got some GREAT NEWS! 

The team have been hard at work, and we've got a brand new update for you! It features a couple of new things that we know players have been asking for, as well as some balancing fixes! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453446/42e72fb30f047b2e15824a3da8d20f58c67d3936.gif

New Features:

Ability to Save and Exit a run at the warp gate exit

You'll now be able to continue on from the next level at the main menu! We know lots of folks are busy, and when you've found THE RUN it's hard to put down - now you're able to do that safely at each end gate, and pick up where you left off next time you play!

Text Resizing
We know some folks were having difficulty with text sizes, so we've added the ability to increase them!

Gems are now awarded upon fully completing a postbox thread
The more you learn about the world around you, the more we now reward you! Get out there and grab those gems!

Lux and Pulsar can now take Upgrade cards to reroll perks
If you've been to Lux and Pulsar's shop and didn't like the upgrades on offer then we want to allow you to build the run that suits you better. With spare upgrade cards, you can now re-roll the perks that they are offering! The cost increases each time you roll but is reset between uses of Lux and Pulsar's table.

New Rooms have been added
What could they hold?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453446/0144daa66c49fe4848a0329831da9160d5e553ba.gif

Fixes and balancing:

 Fixed an issue that was causing older graphics cards/systems to crash when loading into the main menu.
 Adjusted the difficulty to be slightly more forgiving on unlucky or bad runs
 Numerous small vfx tweaks

notes.title: The TombStar Balance Update - 1.0.2 is here!
notes.notes:
Thanks so much to everyone reaching out with their feedback, we've been reading it all over carefully and adjusting the game to put together a balance update for you all! Watching streams, videos and reading threads has been SUPER helpful to us, thank you so much to everyone who has been making content and reaching out! 

Here's what's new: 

Game Changes

 Players progress faster through the meta progression, with level requirements being reduced
 The order in which items are unlocked via the meta progression has been updated
 Added player bios to the discoveries UI
 New players start with 100 gems
 A slight reduction in level 1 difficulty - including bosses
 All bosses have had their damage resistance updated
 Added new rooms, updated some room layouts, Fixed an issue with some floors in the infected biome
 New controller crosshair settings to adjust the crosshair distance
 Confirmation screens added to the pause menu
 All weapons are now automatic firing 
 A.J’s starting weapon’s damage has been slightly nerfed (sorry, sniper fans!)
 Buffed the Firefly weapon


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where upon reaching level 60 players would get stuck with a black screen
 Resolved some issues with game loading, please let us know if these persist
 Ammo counts should no longer go into the negatives
 Fixed issue where the player could still control the character during the final cutscene
 Numerous small optimisation updates and smaller bug fixes

notes.title: TombStar Hotfix Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Howdy everyone!

We want to thank you all again for playing TombStar, we hope you're having a rootin' and tootin' time!

We've pushed a small hotfix update, here's what's changed:


 Added native PS5 Dual Sense controller support
 Added support for multiple controllers connected at the same time
 Updates to the remapping screen to improve behaviour when multiple controllers are plugged in
 Added NEW ability effects for AJ
 Added NEW rooms in the Infected Biomes
 Fixed issues with boss related achievements not registering
 The crosses over eyes should now correctly be placed over the eyes
 Fixed an issue where Rocky Rumble would slide around between attacks
 Fixed an issue where "!" wouldn't disappear after looking at items in the badge store
 Minor performance tweaks


We'll have more details on upcoming updates SOON, please don't forget to keep giving us feedback!

We can't wait to bring you more content - keep an eye out for more news and updates. It's gonna get rowdy!
